Game Overview

Cut Grass Cut puts players into a brain experience centered on race against time as you navigate 30 dynamic lawn patterns with your wheel-shaped shear in Cut Grass Cut. Strategically zip through each level, slicing through unruly grass with precision. With intuitive controls and exhilarating time-crunch challenges, every second is a push towards peak mowing mastery.
